articles.summary: Competition invites engineers to build predictive solutions that reduce waste and extend the life of systems PHOENIX Hackster.io, an Avnet community, in collaboration with Nordic Semiconductor, has launched a new global competition challenging engineers, developers and makers to build predictive monitoring solutions that help equipment, infrastructure and natural resources last longer through early detection and predictive maintenance. The Sustain the System competition invites participants to build intelligent monitoring systems using Nordic Semiconductors nRF54LM20 Development Kit and Bluetooth technology that can detect degradation, predict failures and help reduce waste by extending the life of critical systems. The challenge focuses on practical applications across equipment, infrastructure and natural resource management. Potential projects include greenhouse monitoring, community infrastructure monitoring, water resource management and wildlife health
